title: Workday makes Sana its new home for AI-driven HR and finance
key_facts: At its Workday Rising conference, Workday, a business software company for HR and finance, said Sana, an agentic experience that brings tasks, meetings, decisions and agent activity together, is becoming the new Workday Home (SiliconANGLE).
Workday introduced Sana Concierge, a service agent for HR and IT teams that resolves employee requests such as onboarding, leave and password requests.
Sana can generate interactive applications in real time using Jev, a model from TypeSafe AI.

Workday announced two platforms: Work Intelligence (shows how AI tools change tasks and skills, using Skills Cloud with more than 3,450 customers and 75,000 canonical skills) and Decision Intelligence (shared real-time analysis for HR and finance teams).

Executives described a shift "from copilot to autopilot", for example a recruiter agent that prepares outreach before the recruiter logs in; the employee still reviews outreach and chooses whether to advance candidates.
Workday agreed to acquire ConductorOne Inc., also known as C1.ai, an agentic identity platform that governs which people and AI agents have which access; no price is given in the article.
C1.ai will combine with Workday Agent System of Record.
quote_evidence: Employees will now work directly with Sana to get everything done.
In addition to the Sana updates, Workday announced that it agreed to acquire ConductorOne Inc., also known as C1.ai, an agentic identity platform for people and agents.
Workday’s executives demonstrated a shift from “copilot to autopilot” during a press briefing.
why_it_matters_hint: A large HR and finance software vendor is making an AI assistant its main interface and buying a firm to control what AI agents can access.
notes: Full text read. All product claims are Workday's own, reported by SiliconANGLE; no customer results. Acquisition price and closing date are not given. The ConductorOne purchase is also covered in category 06 as C06-13 (The Business Journals), so the editor may merge duplicates.
